description: The checkout service encounters KeyError crashes when communicating with the inventory repository due to mismatched data dictionary key conventions.
spec_notes: Invariant: Repository expects snake_case keys (product_id, quantity), service was formatting payload with camelCase (productId, itemQty).

repo_files.models.py:
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional

@dataclass
class OrderResult:
    order_id: str
    success: bool
    error: Optional[str] = None

tests.test_service.py:
from repository import InventoryRepository
from service import CheckoutService

def test_repository_read_baseline():
    repo = InventoryRepository()
    svc = CheckoutService(repo)
    # Baseline inspection passes initially
    assert svc.repo.get_stock("item_a") == 10
    assert svc.repo.get_stock("item_b") == 5

def test_successful_checkout():
    repo = InventoryRepository()
    svc = CheckoutService(repo)
    res = svc.checkout("ord_2", "item_a", 3)
    assert res.success is True
    assert repo.get_stock("item_a") == 7

def test_exhaust_stock():
    repo = InventoryRepository()
    svc = CheckoutService(repo)
    res = svc.checkout("ord_3", "item_b", 5)
    assert res.success is True
    assert repo.get_stock("item_b") == 0
